I am a quantitative geographer developing spatial statistical methods to explain **where, and for whom, urban relationships differ**, with applications to housing, mobility and spatial inequality.

My work centres on spatial heterogeneity: spatially varying coefficient models, Moran eigenvector spatial filtering, quantile and compositional regression, and Bayesian modelling. In 2026 I was a visiting researcher at UMR CESAER (INRAE / Institut Agro Dijon), working on income gradients and urban form in French cities.

[I am seeking postdoctoral positions in Europe, especially France, from 2027/28.]{.job-market}

**Contact:** peng.zhan.b5 [at] tohoku.ac.jp

**Languages:** Mandarin (native) · English (fluent) · Japanese (fluent) · French (A2)
